description: This Java class implements a cached attributes service for the Thingsboard platform, managing attribute retrieval, caching, and persistence with support for local and remote cache types, and integrating with other services like EdqsService.

classes.name: CachedAttributesService
classes.description: Service class providing cached attribute management, including retrieval, saving, and deletion, with support for local and remote caches, integrated with other platform services.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the cache executor after construction.

methods.name: getExecutor
methods.description: Returns an executor service based on cache type, either direct or from cacheExecutorService.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Retrieves an attribute value from cache or database for a specific tenant, entity, scope, and key.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Retrieves multiple attributes, using cache when possible, and falling back to database for missing keys.

methods.name: findCachedAttributes
methods.description: Helper method to fetch multiple attributes from cache.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Fetches all attributes for an entity and scope directly from database.

methods.name: findAllKeysByDeviceProfileId
methods.description: Returns all attribute keys associated with a device profile.

methods.name: findAllKeysByEntityIds
methods.description: Returns all attribute keys for a list of entities.

methods.name: findAllKeysByEntityIdsAndScope
methods.description: Returns attribute keys for entities filtered by scope.

methods.name: findAllKeysByEntityIdsAndScopeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version of fetching attribute keys by entity IDs and scope.

methods.name: findLatestByEntityIdsAndScope
methods.description: Fetches latest attribute entries for multiple entities and scope.

methods.name: findLatestByEntityIdsAndScopeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version of fetching latest attribute entries.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a single attribute and updates cache.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves multiple attributes and updates cache.

methods.name: doSave
methods.description: Internal method to persist attributes and update cache, returning save results.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Updates cache with a given attribute for an entity and scope.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes specified attributes from database and cache, and triggers EdqsService on delete.

methods.name: removeAllByEntityId
methods.description: Removes all attributes for an entity and updates cache and EdqsService accordingly.
